name: student_wellness_s26
info: Ohlone College Student Well-Being Study, Spring 2026
Survey of 247 student responses collected April 27-May 1, 2026, during the 13th week of a 16-week semester.
Invitations were sent to 11 faculty members in Communication, English, Math, and Ethnic Studies, as well as all of Jose Rico's classes: three statistics classes and one Math for Liberal Arts class.

The survey asks about student well-being, school support, social connection, sleep, exercise, phone/social media use, money stress, study time, work hours, college goals, major confidence, and demographic background.
This is an observational study based on voluntary survey responses; results can show associations but should not be interpreted as proving cause and effect.
